body:
Track 10, milestone 3 (`swe-value`). A three-level value rubric scored over all 408 `research/` projects by two automated passes (names/order; README text) plus a blind 30-project hand sample.

Results (preliminary, negative on the automated passes): linear kappa A vs B 0.07 (95% bootstrap 0.01 to 0.13). A flaw in pass A (`*-twin` counted as one follow-up chain) was found after the fact; the variant A2 gives 0.25. Against the hand sample: B 0.45, A2 0.57, n=30, rubric author as rater. Follow-ups add about as many lines as new projects.

Checks: 8 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok. README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; run line is the last commit.
